summary: Candidate is a distinct session-level distributed training orchestration skill focused on Accelerate library coordination. It differs semantically from existing skills: not monitoring/telemetry (OpenTelemetry), not script optimization (Third-Party Script), and orthogonal to peer candidates (DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 uses memory optimization; GRPO Trainer and Reward Scaling are RL-specific post-training workflows). Accelerate-centric orchestration is a separate capability in the model_training_infrastructure task family at training_setup stage. Support evidence from GRPO Trainer documentation validates the skill's relevance to multi-node training scenarios.
